per_question.question: ¿Qué pacientes han tenido un ingreso dentro de los tres meses posteriores a un recambio de cadera o rodilla?
agent_sqls:
WITH procedimientos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        p.patient_ref,
        p.episode_ref AS proc_episode_ref,
        p.start_date  AS proc_date,
        p.code,
        p.descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE
        p.code IN (
            '81.51','81.52','81.53',
            '0SR902A','0SR904A','0SRB02A','0SRR01A','0SRR01Z',
            '0SRA01Z','0SRE01Z',
            '81.54','81.55',
            '0SRC0J9','0SRC0L9','0SRC069',
            '0SRD0J9','0SRD0L9','0SRD0N9','0SRD069',
            '0SRW0J9'
        )
),
ingresos AS (
    SELECT
        e.patient_ref,
        e.episode_ref AS hosp_episode_ref,
        e.start_date  AS hosp_start_date
    FROM g_episodes e
    WHERE e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    pr.patient_ref,
    pr.proc_date                          AS fecha_procedimiento,
    pr.code                               AS codigo_procedimiento,
    pr.descr                              AS descripcion_procedimiento,
    ing.hosp_start_date                   AS fecha_ingreso_posterior,
    ing.hosp_episode_ref                  AS episodio_ingreso
FROM procedimientos pr
JOIN ingresos ing
    ON  ing.patient_ref    = pr.patient_ref
    AND ing.hosp_start_date > pr.proc_date
    AND ing.hosp_start_date <= DATE_ADD(pr.proc_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    AND ing.hosp_episode_ref <> pr.proc_episode_ref
ORDER BY pr.patient_ref, pr.proc_date, ing.hosp_start_date;

WITH procedimientos AS (
    -- Recambios de cadera y rodilla
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_ref, p.episode_ref, p.start_date AS proc_date, p.descr AS proc_descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE
        -- Cadera: ICD-9 y ICD-10
        p.code IN ('81.51','81.52','81.53')
        OR p.code LIKE '0SR9%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRB%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRA%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRE%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRR%'
        -- Rodilla: ICD-9 y ICD-10
        OR p.code IN ('81.54','81.55')
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRC%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRD%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRW%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRT%'
),
reingresos AS (
    -- Ingresos posteriores dentro de los 3 meses
    SELECT
        pr.patient_ref,
        pr.proc_date,
        pr.proc_descr,
        e.episode_ref AS reingreso_episode_ref,
        e.start_date  AS reingreso_fecha,
        DATEDIFF(e.start_date, pr.proc_date) AS dias_hasta_reingreso
    FROM procedimientos pr
    JOIN g_episodes e
        ON e.patient_ref = pr.patient_ref
        AND e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'
        AND e.start_date > pr.proc_date
        AND e.start_date <= DATE_ADD(pr.proc_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        AND e.episode_ref <> pr.episode_ref  -- excluir el mismo episodio del procedimiento
)
SELECT
    r.patient_ref,
    r.proc_descr                          AS procedimiento,
    DATE(r.proc_date)                     AS fecha_procedimiento,
    r.reingreso_episode_ref,
    DATE(r.reingreso_fecha)               AS fecha_reingreso,
    r.dias_hasta_reingreso
FROM reingresos r
ORDER BY r.patient_ref, r.proc_date, r.reingreso_fecha;

WITH procedimientos AS (
    -- Recambios de cadera
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_ref, p.episode_ref, p.start_date AS proc_date, p.descr AS proc_descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE (
        p.code IN ('81.51','81.52','81.53')                          -- ICD-9: sustitución/revisión cadera
        OR p.code IN ('81.54','81.55')                               -- ICD-9: sustitución/revisión rodilla
        OR p.code LIKE '0SR9%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRB%'               -- ICD-10: sustitución cadera derecha/izquierda
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRA%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRE%'               -- ICD-10: sustitución cadera acetabular
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRR%'                                       -- ICD-10: sustitución cadera femoral
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRC%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRD%'               -- ICD-10: sustitución rodilla derecha/izquierda
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRW%'                                       -- ICD-10: sustitución rodilla tibial
    )
),
ingresos AS (
    SELECT e.patient_ref, e.episode_ref, e.start_date AS ingreso_date
    FROM g_episodes e
    WHERE e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    pr.patient_ref,
    pr.proc_descr                          AS procedimiento,
    pr.proc_date                           AS fecha_procedimiento,
    ing.episode_ref                        AS episodio_ingreso,
    ing.ingreso_date                       AS fecha_ingreso,
    DATEDIFF(ing.ingreso_date, pr.proc_date) AS dias_hasta_ingreso
FROM procedimientos pr
JOIN ingresos ing
    ON ing.patient_ref = pr.patient_ref
    AND ing.ingreso_date > pr.proc_date
    AND ing.ingreso_date <= DATE_ADD(pr.proc_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    AND ing.episode_ref <> pr.episode_ref   -- excluir el mismo episodio del procedimiento
ORDER BY pr.patient_ref, pr.proc_date, ing.ingreso_date

per_question.question: En pacientes con diagnóstico de glaucoma, ¿qué procedimientos quirúrgicos relacionados con glaucoma han sido realizados y cuándo ocurrieron en relación con el diagnóstico?
agent_sqls:
WITH primer_diag AS (
    -- Primer diagnóstico de glaucoma por paciente
    SELECT
        patient_ref,
        MIN(diag_date) AS primera_diag_date,
        MAX(code)      AS diag_code,
        MAX(diag_descr) AS diag_descr
    FROM g_diagnostics
    WHERE code LIKE 'H40%'
    GROUP BY patient_ref
),
procedimientos_unicos AS (
    -- Procedimientos quirúrgicos de glaucoma únicos por paciente
    SELECT DISTINCT
        patient_ref,
        code AS proc_code,
        TRIM(descr) AS proc_descr,
        start_date  AS proc_date
    FROM g_procedures
    WHERE code IN ('12.64', '12.65')
      AND start_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    pd.patient_ref,
    pd.diag_code,
    pd.diag_descr,
    DATE(pd.primera_diag_date)  AS fecha_primer_diagnostico,
    pu.proc_code,
    pu.proc_descr,
    DATE(pu.proc_date)          AS fecha_procedimiento,
    CASE
        WHEN pu.proc_date < pd.primera_diag_date
            THEN CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, pu.proc_date, pd.primera_diag_date), ' días ANTES del primer diagnóstico')
        WHEN DATE(pu.proc_date) = DATE(pd.primera_diag_date)
            THEN 'Mismo día que el primer diagnóstico'
        ELSE
            CONCAT(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, pd.primera_diag_date, pu.proc_date), ' días DESPUÉS del primer diagnóstico')
    END AS relacion_temporal
FROM primer_diag pd
JOIN procedimientos_unicos pu ON pu.patient_ref = pd.patient_ref
ORDER BY pd.patient_ref, pu.proc_date

WITH glaucoma_diag AS (
    SELECT
        d.patient_ref,
        d.episode_ref,
        d.diag_date,
        d.code AS diag_code,
        d.diag_descr
    FROM g_diagnostics d
    WHERE d.code LIKE 'H40%'
),
glaucoma_proc AS (
    SELECT
        p.patient_ref,
        p.episode_ref,
        p.start_date AS proc_date,
        p.code AS proc_code,
        p.descr AS proc_descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.code IN ('12.64', '12.65')
)
SELECT
    gp.patient_ref,
    gd.diag_code,
    gd.diag_descr,
    gd.diag_date,
    gp.proc_code,
    gp.proc_descr,
    gp.proc_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, gd.diag_date, gp.proc_date) AS dias_diag_a_proc,
    CASE
        WHEN gp.proc_date < gd.diag_date THEN 'Procedimiento ANTES del diagnóstico'
        WHEN gp.proc_date = gd.diag_date THEN 'Mismo día'
        ELSE 'Procedimiento DESPUÉS del diagnóstico'
    END AS relacion_temporal
FROM glaucoma_proc gp
JOIN glaucoma_diag gd ON gd.patient_ref = gp.patient_ref
ORDER BY gp.patient_ref, gp.proc_date

WITH diag_glaucoma AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        d.patient_ref,
        d.episode_ref,
        d.code AS diag_code,
        d.diag_descr,
        d.diag_date
    FROM g_diagnostics d
    WHERE d.code LIKE 'H40%'
),
proc_glaucoma AS (
    SELECT
        p.patient_ref,
        p.episode_ref,
        p.code AS proc_code,
        p.descr AS proc_descr,
        p.start_date AS proc_date
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.code IN ('12.64', '12.65', '12.67')
),
pacientes_con_ambos AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dg.patient_ref
    FROM diag_glaucoma dg
    WHERE dg.patient_ref IN (SELECT patient_ref FROM proc_glaucoma)
)
SELECT
    pg.patient_ref,
    pg.proc_code,
    TRIM(pg.proc_descr)                                         AS procedimiento,
    pg.proc_date                                                AS fecha_procedimiento,
    dg.diag_code,
    dg.diag_descr                                               AS diagnostico_glaucoma,
    dg.diag_date                                                AS fecha_diagnostico,
    DATEDIFF(pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date)                        AS dias_diag_a_proc,
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date) < 0  THEN 'Procedimiento ANTES del diagnóstico'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date) = 0  THEN 'Mismo día'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date) <= 30 THEN 'Hasta 1 mes después'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date) <= 180 THEN '1-6 meses después'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date) <= 365 THEN '6-12 meses después'
        ELSE 'Más de 1 año después'
    END                                                         AS relacion_temporal
FROM proc_glaucoma pg
JOIN diag_glaucoma dg ON pg.patient_ref = dg.patient_ref
WHERE pg.patient_ref IN (SELECT patient_ref FROM pacientes_con_ambos)
ORDER BY pg.patient_ref, pg.proc_date, dg.diag_date;

per_question.question: ¿Cuáles son los valores máximo y mínimo de creatinina encontrados, por cada subtipo de enfermedad renal crónica, en pacientes de entre 50 y 70 años?
agent_sqls:
SELECT
    d.code,
    d.diag_descr,
    MAX(l.result_num) AS creatinina_max,
    MIN(l.result_num) AS creatinina_min
FROM g_diagnostics d
JOIN g_episodes e ON e.patient_ref = d.patient_ref AND e.episode_ref = d.episode_ref
JOIN g_labs l ON l.patient_ref = d.patient_ref
JOIN g_demographics dem ON dem.patient_ref = d.patient_ref
WHERE (d.code LIKE 'N18%' OR d.code LIKE 'I12%' OR d.code LIKE 'I13%')
  AND d.code NOT IN ('D63.1')
  AND l.lab_sap_ref = 'LAB2467'
  AND l.result_num IS NOT NULL
  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, dem.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 50 AND 70
GROUP BY d.code, d.diag_descr
ORDER BY d.code

SELECT
    d.code,
    d.diag_descr,
    MAX(l.result_num) AS creatinina_max,
